plants.plant_name: Nakota Data Center Campus Power Plant

extra_brief:
This pass is a second look at the location only. The first agent asked for it. Research nothing but the three location fields, and write the shard to a new path so the first shard is kept.

- Applied Digital ELN Generation Plant (L100001089074): The point comes from an interpolated street address and the imagery is older than construction, so the site itself was not seen.
  The first agent wrote: The draft permit lists 60 Caterpillar 3516E engines in building ELN02, matching the database. No start year or operating date is stated. The project is moving, so Latest Activity is left alone.
- Nakota Data Center Campus Power Plant (L100001084854): The database point is in open farmland about 28 kilometers from where the document puts the campus. Imagery of a point 5 miles west of Williston shows an industrial area and not a 620 acre site, so no new point is proposed.
  The first agent wrote: No Public Service Commission case or Department of Environmental Quality air permit was found for Tachyon9, Nixxy or Nakota. The news is from June and July 2026, so the project is active.
